description:
Prices ONE cart in the shop's own public cart (Shopify or WooCommerce) to ONE ZIP, with no personal data, and orders nothing: the cart is emptied afterwards.
Answers the items, delivery options with their prices, the subtotal and what stays unknown (tax and fees at checkout; the delivery date unless the cart names it — `delivery_date` asks for a day).
Other platforms answer «quote not available» with the reason and the order link.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE VERSUM CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.

address_1.description: street line, only for the price: some shops price by it

state.description: two letters; read from the postcode when omitted

deliver_to.description: where it must be brought: "33139", "Miami Beach, FL 33139", or {postcode, state, city, address_1}

delivery_date.description: the day the person wants it delivered ("2026-11-20"): answered as confirmed only when the shop's cart names that day, else «delivery date: unknown»

items.description: several different items of the SAME shop in one cart (delivery and tax on the whole order); offering_id is then the first of them

offering_id.description: the offering id from a card

field.description: words of the page’s own question, e.g. «card»

value.description: the answer, e.g. «No», or the card message

options.description: answers to the product page’s own add-on questions; the rest are answered «no»

variant_id.description: a variant id from the card when it lists several

name: quote_order
title: What an order would cost delivered to an address — asked of the shop’s own cart, nothing ordered
